title: Visually Grounded Language Learning: a review of language games, datasets, tasks, and models

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing datasets (such as MaRVL) that evaluate whether visually grounded language models can generalize beyond Eurocentric/American visual concepts by testing multicultural reasoning across geographically, typologically, and genealogically diverse languages.

Analyzing evaluation frameworks, balancing procedures, and diagnostic datasets (like CLEVR and GQA) designed to test if models exploit statistical shortcuts or rely on a single modality (e.g., text only) rather than demonstrating true multi-modal visual grounding.
